rationale: All start runs are feasible with wide margins (0 DRC, hold slack >= +0.07 ns, <=33 slew/cap pins vs bar 309), so the score is driven by the target. Loose targets (0.93-0.98) gave poor T_eff (9.0-10.1) since repair stops once the target is met; tight ones (0.48-0.52) gave 6.96-7.64 with positive slack. Best, md5 at 0.497 -> 6.955 (slack +0.8), is below the 0.45 floor (7.02 ns), so pin 0.45 for near-limit, trustworthy T_eff. Also pin best-run choices matching the tight-run trend: AREA 3 (AREA 2 missed 8.98 ns), cap213 (top two tight runs), timing-driven placement, post-GRT timing repair, no routability spreading. Leave synthesis buffering/sizing, util, density and margins to TPE.
